name: ProjectDiscovery Chaos dataset API (dns.projectdiscovery.io)
tier_rationale: Established security company with published terms, public API documentation and open-source tooling (chaos-client, subfinder); council P007 cond 1 names Chaos (ProjectDiscovery) trusted (A8).

reliability.justification: Curated subdomain dataset with best coverage for bug-bounty programmes; names are labels without the apex (appended by the module) and include wildcard labels.

chaos.description: ProjectDiscovery Chaos API key (raw value in the Authorization header)
chaos.plan_hint: business = a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (never an analyst's personal free account, P007 cond 3); key_plans.chaos='business' unlocks it under the corporate profile

subdomains.title: Chaos subdomains of a domain (GET /dns/{domain}/subdomains)

terms.quote: P007 cond 3 (binding council text): key-terms per adapter - a company/team account, never an analyst's personal free account, on a plan whose terms permit internal business use; legal records the plan and the terms URL in the registry before the adapter runs under the corporate profile (A1).

subdomains.notes: Research C0016 (verified_needs_key, 401 without key). Answer {domain, subdomains[labels without the apex], count}: the module appends '.{domain}' (P007 cond 4); '*' and '*.x' labels are wildcard records of the parent. Never call POST /dns/add (it uploads subdomains) and never add chaos-client's ?sdk=true telemetry. chaos-client README: 60 requests/min per IP (quota block). Used by subdomains_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-1 (P007, module subdomains_keyed). The keyless bulk dataset chaos-data.projectdiscovery.io is outside the final conditions and not registered (docs/backlog/p3-G01-1.md).
